batch: Storage Sense machine enforcement policy candidate implementation and local validation
source: Repository catalog, tests, operator guide, Microsoft Storage Policy CSP

candidate.scope: Machine-level AllowStorageSenseGlobal policy, separate from the existing current-user preference.

effects.enabled: Forces Storage Sense on; users cannot disable it.
effects.disabled: Forces Storage Sense off; users cannot enable it.
effects.windowsDefault: Removes only this local policy override and returns control to Windows/user behavior, which may enable it under low storage.

boundaries: Does not configure cadence, temporary-file cleanup, Downloads, Recycle Bin or cloud content.
Exact registry restore does not recover deleted files.
Microsoft CSP edition list is Pro, Enterprise, Education and IoT Enterprise; Home and Server are not candidate targets.
acceptanceRequired: Confirm Windows 11 edition and actual UI enforcement.
Confirm cleanup boundary with expendable fixture content.

changes: Cataloged the separate machine policy candidate with no supported targets and pending Windows 11 acceptance.
Added focused metadata and engine state-match tests; candidate excluded from profiles.
Updated Storage Sense operator guide and remaining-settings decision row.

validation.repositoryValidation: Passed: 447 operations, 8 groups, 5 profiles, 301 PowerShell files.

focusedPester.result: No result/count obtained. The isolated PowerShell/Pester invocation ended with a FileSystem InitializeDefaultDrives provider error and no Pester summary; assertion execution cannot be confirmed.

deferred: Native Windows 11 UI/effective policy, edition and exact restoration acceptance; no supported target declared.
partial: Separate advanced Storage Sense machine-policy candidate is cataloged, documented and statically validated; no legacy outcome closed.

estimates.adjustment: None; candidate preparation and static validation do not establish a legacy outcome or Windows behavior.
